identificationModule.officialTitle: A Study of GC019F CAR-T Cell Immunotherapy for Relapsed or Refractory B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This study is an early, open, single-centered trial. The major aim of this study is to evaluate the safety and tolerance of GC019F CAR-T cell immunotherapy in relapsed or refractory B-ALL. The study will include 6-12 subjects to receive GC019F single infusion.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse events(AE)
primaryOutcomes.description: AEs will be collected and graded according to ASTCT consensus(for Cytokine Release Syndrome, CRS and Immune Effector Cell-Associated Neurotoxicity Syndrome, ICANS) and CTCAE v5.0(for AE except for CRS/ICANS )

secondaryOutcomes.measure: CAR copies and concentration of GC007F in peripheral blood, bone marrow and CSF
secondaryOutcomes.description: GC007F CAR copies and cells in peripheral blood, bone marrow and CSF will be measured by qPCR and FCM in 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Overall response rate (ORR) and minimal residual disease negative (MRD-) rate of patients who received GC007F infusion
secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR will be estimated as the percentage of patients who achieved CR or CRi. MRD- rate will be estimated as the percentage of patients who achieved MRD-(blast cells in bone marrow\<10\^-4 as determined by FCM).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Duration of response (DOR), progression-free survival (PFS), overall survival (OS) of patients who received GC007F infusion
secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR refers to the time interval from the date when the patient was evaluated as CR/CRi for the first time to the date when the patient was evaluated as disease relapse or death due to any reason. PFS refers to the time interval from the date of GC007F infusion to the date when the patient was evaluated as disease relapse or death due to any reason. OS refers to the time interval from the date of GC007F infusion to the date when the patient died due to any reason.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Concentration of anti-GC007F antibody after infusion
secondaryOutcomes.description: After GC007F infusion, GC007F antibody in peripheral blood will be measured in 2 years
